Weaknesses: scope drift, one-sided framing, no alternative source viewpoints, and an unattributed ending quote. No call to action in the stored text.

script.analysis: A cold open built on three viewer questions (how, is it safe, what if I stop) opens a discovery-and-persistence story whose engine is repeated failure (216 versions) and a clever analogy that resolves the problem; the ad is placed at the bottleneck (failure 216, success next) so that resolution follows the ad. Later sections shift to a commercial and social story (shortage, gray market, regain) that echoes the cold-open safety questions. The ending introduces a longevity quote not supported by the argument. Strengths: topic matched to a broad audience, strong analogy, clear arc from science to market. Weaknesses: medical claims unsourced, weak ending, loose revenue claim.
